propositions: autodeploy.sh recreates the review-bot container without draining in-flight reviews, killing reconciler retry paths before they vote, causing the LLM-Review gate to live-lock during landing bursts when deploys arrive faster than reviews complete
the bot's own shutdown grace period and queue drain protect webhook-queued reviews but not the reconciler's inline review_and_vote calls, making the self-heal mechanism the unprotected path
a fully live-locked gate with zero votes emits no VOTER_ERROR and triggers no CloudWatch alarms, leaving the failure mode invisible to existing health monitoring
during measured landing bursts, seven recreations in 90 minutes with gaps shorter than a single review's ~10-minute runtime caused changes to hang unvotable for 20-35 minutes
deferring deploys when in_flight > 0 (up to a bound of 1800s keyed to the deferral episode, not the target SHA) prevents mid-review interruption while allowing idle deploys to proceed
